# Slack Multilingual Executive Assistant Snippets

A public, safe overview of a Slack-based multilingual AI executive assistant built in n8n. The system uses a central AI agent with specialized MCP tool workflows for Outlook email, calendar, contacts, attachments, drafts, folders, web search, and date/time handling.

The assistant is designed for natural-language work requests. A user can write in one language, ask the assistant to draft an email in another language, look up the recipient from Outlook contacts, check calendar availability, preview the message, and send it only after approval.

This repository documents the architecture decisions and implementation approach from a private automation project. The examples are rewritten for public review so the technical work can be discussed without exposing personal data, workspace identifiers, credentials, n8n cloud endpoints, mailbox content, or raw workflow exports.

> Original n8n workflow JSON, Slack channel IDs, user IDs, credential IDs, tenant configuration, private MCP URLs, contact records, calendar entries, and mailbox content are not part of this repository. The snippets are public-safe examples with neutral names and generic placeholders.

---

## What This Pattern Solves

Personal admin work often crosses several systems:

- finding a person in contacts
- checking the calendar for the next free time
- drafting an email in the correct tone and language
- attaching or referencing files when needed
- creating drafts or folders
- confirming what will happen before the action is executed

ARIA turns those steps into one Slack conversation while keeping a human approval gate before sensitive actions such as sending an email.

Example request shape:

```text
Write to my contact about today's lunch. Apologize in a friendly tone because I cannot make it. Check my next free calendar slot and include that date. Draft the email in Romanian and show it to me before sending.
```

The assistant interprets the request, calls the right tools, prepares a preview, and waits for approval.

---

## Architecture at a Glance

```text
Slack message
    |
    v
Smart Processor
    |  normalizes text, user context, language, priority, attachments
    v
Smart Router
    |------------------------------|
    v                              v
Command Center                 ARIA Agent
(help/status/quick actions)       |
                                  | uses tools
        -------------------------------------------------
        |          |          |          |              |
        v          v          v          v              v
   Email MCP  Calendar MCP  Contacts MCP  Drafts MCP  Attachments MCP
        |          |          |          |              |
        -------------------------------------------------
                                  |
                                  v
                          Approval Preview
                                  |
                                  v
                         Slack confirmation
```

See [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md) for the full workflow breakdown.

---

```text
    `-- response-cleaner.js
```

The snippets are adapted from real n8n Code-node patterns. They show implementation shape and reliability decisions without republishing the original workflow exports.

---

## Tech Stack

- **Orchestration:** n8n
- **Control surface:** Slack trigger and Slack message delivery
- **AI:** Azure OpenAI through n8n LangChain nodes
- **Tool pattern:** MCP client tools and MCP trigger workflows
- **Productivity tools:** Microsoft Outlook email, calendar, contacts, attachments, drafts, folders
- **Search:** SerpAPI web search tool
- **Code:** JavaScript in n8n Code nodes

---

## Purpose

I use this repository to explain the technical structure behind a multilingual Slack AI assistant: how natural-language requests are normalized, routed, delegated to specialized tools, reviewed through an approval step, and confirmed back in Slack.

The full portfolio case study is available at [valentinoveljanovski.de/projects/slack-multilingual-executive-assistant](https://valentinoveljanovski.de/projects/slack-multilingual-executive-assistant).
